goal: If I wanted to reach out to the three single-family offices in this dataset most likely to consider a co-investment in a healthcare services deal, which three would you recommend, and what specific evidence would you point to if I asked you to justify the shortlist to my investment committee?

result.text: The information provided only tells us that several family offices, including Council Ring Capital, Mitchell Family Office, Wexner Family Office, TriEdge Investments, Beemok Capital, and Bezos Expeditions, invest in Healthcare and Life Sciences, but it does not indicate which are single-family offices or which are most likely to consider a co-investment in a healthcare services deal, so I cannot reliably recommend a specific shortlist of three. Council Ring Capital invests in Healthcare and Life Sciences alongside Private Equity, Direct Investments in Private Companies, Technology and Innovation, and Public Equities, which shows sector alignment with healthcare but does not by itself demonstrate co-investment appetite or confirm single-family office status. Mitchell Family Office invests in Healthcare and Life Sciences as well as Private Equity, Real Estate, Public Equities, and Direct Investments in Private Companies, again indicating relevant sector focus but not providing evidence about co-investment behavior or single-family office status. Wexner Family Office invests in Healthcare and Life Sciences together with Real Estate, Public Equities, Private Equity, Fixed Income, and Impact Investing / ESG, which is relevant thematically but still does not establish that it is a single-family office willing to co-invest in healthcare services deals. TriEdge Investments invests in Healthcare and Life Sciences, Venture Capital, Direct Investments in Private Companies, and Technology and Innovation, which suggests interest in healthcare-related private deals but offers no direct evidence of co-investment preferences or single-family office structure. Beemok Capital invests in Healthcare and Life Sciences, Private Equity, Real Estate, Direct Investments in Private Companies, and Impact Investing / ESG, but the data does not state whether it is a single-family office or whether it typically pursues co-investments. Bezos Expeditions invests in Healthcare and Life Sciences along with Private Equity, Venture Capital, Direct Investments in Private Companies, Technology and Innovation, and Impact Investing / ESG, yet there is no information here about its co-investment practices or confirmation that it operates as a single-family office.
result.shortfall: The claims only specify sector focus (including Healthcare and Life Sciences) for each firm and do not indicate: (1) which firms are definitively single-family offices versus multi-family or other structures; (2) any history or stated preference for co-investments; or (3) any specific focus on healthcare services as distinct from broader Healthcare and Life Sciences. Therefore I cannot defensibly identify the three single-family offices most likely to consider a co-investment in a healthcare services deal.
